signature.one_line: Footage-free one-word kinetic cards on flat colours: fill/outline stutter stack, mock follow-click end card.
unique_devices: Hook word repeated in a 5-row stack that grows outward from the centre, rows alternating solid fill and outline-only, one row every 8-10 frames @30
Key-noun exit: the word hard-cuts into a full-height column of ~11 copies that scrolls up out of frame in ~6 frames
Mock social-app profile row with a 'Follow' pill that an animated hand cursor clicks, hard-switching to a filled 'Following' state while the background flashes
Background colour change on every beat (surface colour, near-black, second accent, white) stands in for picture cuts
signature.why_it_works: Beat-locked one-word cards carry zero reading load, the stutter is a pure pattern interrupt, and the end card literally demonstrates the action asked for.

hook.first_frame: Empty flat surface colour-surface colour card; the first filled hook word lands at frame centre within 2-3 frames

structure.what: One short hook word repeated into a 5-row fill/outline stack on a light card
Two-word imperative on two fixed lines, black on the same light card
Wipe to a near-black card; function words as outline stacks, the verb in white fill, the key noun in accent, then the key noun multiplies and scrolls out
One-word CTA verb on a second accent card
Wordmark + mock social profile row; cursor clicks Follow, button flips to Following; background flashes second accent/white

pacing.pace: moderate (cards), but text steps every 8-10 frames

background_text.what: Beat word (kinetic title), one word per beat, ALL CAPS condensed grotesque
background_text.when: 1-62 % of runtime (hook, claim, setup, CTA verb)
background_text.how: Horizontally centred, block centre 49.4-50.2 % H; filled words 166 px Anton 400 at 1080x1920 (ink ~7.2-7.6 % H); each word hard-cuts in place of the previous one every 9-10 frames @30; no fade, scale or idle motion; 2-line blocks on fixed slots 44.6 % / 55 % H, line 2 lands +8 frames

background_text.what: Outline rows of the word stack
background_text.when: hook (0-13 % build) and setup function words
background_text.how: Same 166 px size, transparent fill, ~7-8 px stroke drawn outside the glyph; white stroke on both card colours
CTA tier 138 px Anton 400, black, centred at 49.4 % H, hard cut in

motion_graphics.when: hook, rows land at ~1/4/7/10/13 % of runtime
motion_graphics.how: 5 rows, pitch 9.93 % H (gap 2.7 % H), centres 29.7/39.6/49.5/59.5/69.4 % H; order centre fill -> outline above -> outline below -> fill above -> fill below; each row hard-cuts in, one every 8-10 frames @30
Key noun hard-cuts into a full-height column of ~11 copies (pitch ~3.4 % H) that scrolls upward out of frame in ~6 frames @30 (power2.in), leaving the empty dark card

motion_graphics.what: Cursor click on mock follow button
motion_graphics.how: Hand cursor enters below the button and glides up onto it in ~9 frames (power2.out), rests ~33 frames, clicks: pill hard-switches from white outlined 'Follow' to filled dark 'Following'

cards_lists.what: Flat colour cards as the whole canvas
cards_lists.how: Light cards surface colour / second accent / white with black text; dark card near-black with white text and one accent key noun; one colour per beat

layout.what: Single centred text column, no footage
layout.how: All type centred on the vertical axis at ~50 % H; nothing in the top/bottom 25 % except stack rows

transitions.how: Dark card wipes in from the left edge over ~6 frames @30 (linear), text static under it
Hard cut to second accent; CTA word lands +6 frames after the background
Background white, flashing second accent for ~7 frames @30 twice before the click, white from the click to the end

end_card.how: Wordmark centred at 49.4 % H; profile row revealed from below in 2-3 frames: app-style gradient avatar circle (diameter 6.3 % W, x 25.5-31.8 %, centre y 56.8 %), account name in small bold grey sans (Inter 700, cap height ~1.1 % H, x 33.8-48.8 %), white 'Follow' pill with 1 px light-grey outline (x 60.3-74.4 %, y 55.8-57.7 %, small radius)

other_text_spec.font_class: condensed all-caps grotesque, bold, uniform stroke, rounded-rectangle O/C bowls

closest_match.note: original stems are lighter (stem ~1/7 of cap height vs Anton ~1/4.5); Anton matches height/width proportions and is the size-verified local face

other_text_spec.layout: single word, horizontally centred, block centre y 49.4-50.2 % of H; 2-line blocks keep fixed slots (line 1 centre 44.6 %, line 2 centre 55 %, block centre 49.7 %), no reflow

fill.color: #000000 on light cards; #FFFFFF on the dark card; the one key noun #F7D328 on the dark card

outline.stroke: ~7-8 px @1920, outside the glyph edge (outline word is 0.78 % H taller and 1.4 % W wider than the filled word at the same size)
outline.note: a fit of 181 px includes the outside stroke; it is not the font size: use 166 px plus the stroke

cta.wordmark_reference: a ~12-character wordmark measured 6.17 % H x 58.5 % W at the same size
cta.note: CTA word and wordmark are ~15 % smaller than hook/setup words

stack.pattern: fill / outline / fill / outline / fill (fill rows black on mint; on the dark card the centre row is white fill and the rows above/below white outline)
stack.build_order: centre fill row first, then outline above, outline below, fill above, fill below (grows outward from the centre)

animation.entry: hard cut, no fade/scale/slide: each word or stack row appears complete in one frame
animation.stack_timing: one new row every 8-10 frames; rows land at ~1, 4, 7, 10, 13 % of runtime
animation.word_timing: words change every 9-10 frames on the dark card; 2-line claim: line 2 lands +8 frames after line 1
animation.replace: each new word hard-cuts in place of the previous one (no cross-fade)
animation.key_noun_exit: key noun hard-cuts into a full-height column of 11 copies, which scrolls up out of frame in ~6 frames, leaving the empty dark card

other_text_spec.text: light -> dark: the dark card wipes in from the left edge over ~6 frames (25/50/75/100 % covered at even steps), text static on both cards; dark -> lime: hard cut, CTA word lands +6 frames later

wordmark (cta tier, black, centre y 49.4 %, 46.3-52.5 %) hard-cuts in; 1 frame later a profile row reveals from below over 2-3 frames: app-style gradient avatar circle (diameter 6.3 % of W, x 25.5-31.8 %, centre y 56.8 %), account name in a bold neo-grotesque (closest local Inter 700) #343434, cap height ~1.1 % of H, x 33.8-48.8 %; 'Follow' button: white pill with #BBBBBB 1 px outline, x 60.3-74.4 % (14.1 % of W), y 55.8-57.7 % (1.9 % of H), radius ~3 px @1920
other_text_spec.motion: hand cursor appears below the button ~9 frames after the card lands and glides onto it in ~9 frames; click ~33 frames later (~80 % of runtime): button hard-switches to filled #343434 with white 'Following'
other_text_spec.bg_flashes: white from ~61 %; lime #E4FEA3 for ~7 frames at ~72 % and again at ~78 %; white from the click to the end

style.look_intent: flat graphic colour fields, high contrast, muted pastel light cards against near-black, slightly warm; no footage to grade

sound.music: music-only (beat periodicity 0.49, ~67 bpm estimate); upbeat, beat-driven bed carrying every text step
sfx: none identified; half of the hard cuts land on a music onset (measured cut_hit_share 0.5)
optional: soft click on the cursor click of the follow button

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: the user has no footage and wants a short text-only promo or follow/subscribe CTA
the concept is a punchy 2-4 beat message (hook, offer, CTA) set to music
a CTA end card or text-only cold open is needed to bolt onto another edit
the brand has 2-4 bold flat colours and a condensed display face
avoid_when: the video is a talking head or interview that needs speech captions
the message needs more than ~10 words or any explanation
the brand look is premium/editorial where flashing colour cards feel cheap
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B01 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B01.json) to this brand.
This blueprint has NO speech captions: it is a footage-free kinetic title / follow-CTA sequence. If the edit has speech, caption it with its own spec; use this for the title cards and end card. Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: text vs card >= 7:1, {{ACCENT}} >= 3:1 on {{CARD_BG}}, light cards stay light and the dark card stays dark)
- {{TEXT}}: text on light cards, default #000000 (white #FFFFFF on the dark card)
- {{ACCENT}}: the one key noun on the dark card, default #F7D328
- {{ACCENT_2}}: second light card (CTA card, end-card flashes), default #E4FEA3
- {{SURFACE}}: first light card (hook), default #B2F4B5
- {{CARD_BG}}: dark card, default #161616
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Anton 400 (look: Bebas Neue-like condensed caps)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Inter 700 (profile-row account name)
- {{HANDLE}}: account name on the mock profile row, default "@handle"
- {{LOGO}}: wordmark text or logo on the end card and the avatar circle image

TITLE CARDS
1. {{FONT_DISPLAY}}, ALL CAPS, one word per beat, no punctuation/emoji, tracking 0, no stroke/shadow/box on filled words.
2. Size: beat words 166 px (calibration "HEY" ink 7.19 % H x 21.2 % W; "SCROLLING" 7.34 % / 59.7 %; "PROMOTE" 7.58 % / 53.5 %). CTA word and wordmark 138 px ("FOLLOW" 6.17 % H / 36.9 % W). If {{FONT_DISPLAY}} is not Anton, re-solve px with VERIFY.
3. Position: every word horizontally centred, block centre 49.5-50 % H. Two-line blocks use fixed slots (line 1 centre 44.6 %, line 2 centre 55 %); line 1 does not move when line 2 lands (+8 frames).
4. Hook stack (first ~24 % of runtime): repeat the hook word in a 5-row stack, pitch 9.93 % H (gap 2.7 % H), row centres 29.7 / 39.6 / 49.5 / 59.5 / 69.4 %. Rows alternate FILL / OUTLINE / FILL / OUTLINE / FILL on {{SURFACE}}: fill rows {{TEXT}}, outline rows transparent with a white ~7-8 px stroke outside the glyph (same 166 px size). Build order: centre fill, outline above, outline below, fill above, fill below; each row hard-cuts in, one every 8-10 frames. Then hard-cut to a two-word imperative on the 2-line slots.
5. Dark card: {{CARD_BG}} with white text; function words as white outline stacks, the verb in white fill, the ONE key noun in {{ACCENT}}. One word every 9-10 frames, each hard-cutting in place of the previous; no fades, scale or idle motion.
6. Transitions: light -> dark is a left-to-right wipe of the new card over ~6 frames, text static under it. Key-noun exit: the word hard-cuts into a full-height column of ~11 copies (pitch ~3.4 % H) that scrolls up out of frame in ~6 frames (power2.in). Then hard cut to the {{ACCENT_2}} CTA card; the CTA verb lands 6 frames after the background.

OTHER TEXT / END CARD (last ~36 % of runtime)
7. {{LOGO}} wordmark (138 px, {{TEXT}}, centre 49.4 % H) on white; 1 frame later a profile row reveals from below in 2-3 frames: gradient avatar circle with {{LOGO}} (diameter 6.3 % W, x 25.5-31.8 %, centre y 56.8 %), {{HANDLE}} in {{FONT_BODY}} #343434 (cap height ~1.1 % H, x 33.8-48.8 %), white "Follow" pill with 1 px #BBBBBB outline (14.1 % W x 1.9 % H at x 60.3-74.4 %, y 55.8-57.7 %, radius ~3 px).
8. A hand cursor appears below the pill ~9 frames after the card, glides onto it in ~9 frames (power2.out), clicks ~33 frames later: the pill hard-switches to filled #343434 with white "Following". Background flashes {{ACCENT_2}} for ~7 frames twice before the click, then stays white to the end.

SOUND: music only, beat-driven; place word and row steps on beats; optional soft click on the cursor click. Master to about -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: flat graphic colour fields, high contrast, muted pastels against near-black (no footage in this blueprint, so only inserted footage would be graded).

VERIFY before rendering: render the calibration words and measure them:
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_hook_stack> --box 0.1,0.2,0.9,0.8 --ink "#000000:30"
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_cta_word> --box 0.1,0.2,0.9,0.8 --ink "#000000:30"
Filled "HEY" must read ink 7.19 % +-0.5 of H and width 21.2 % +-2 of W; "FOLLOW" 6.17 % +-0.5 / 36.9 % +-2. For the brand's own words, compute the expected ink with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py at 166 px / 138 px in {{FONT_DISPLAY}}. Positions within +-1 % of frame height of the values above.
